body.title: Add the hook entry program
body.summary: Add the small non-interactive program under src/bin that calls the daemon's tracker.sync with the repository path and no epicHash over the shared rpc client with a short timeout and always exits 0; list it with the other bins so the build compiles it into out/bin.
acceptanceChecks: The entry exits 0 when the daemon is not running, when the call times out, when the daemon answers an error and when the repository is not registered
The entry imports only the rpc client and the paths module and runs one rpc call with a timeout
The build compiles the entry into out/bin and package.json lists it

tests.name: src/bin/__tests__/insrc-git-hook.test.ts: the hook entry exits 0 when the daemon is not running, times out, answers an error or names an unregistered repository
